Commentary of al-Jaza'iri (Aysar al-Tafasir) on surah 78, verse 17–30:

Explanation of the words:

Inna yawm al-fasl (the Day of Decision): that is, the separation between creatures, "so that He may recompense every soul for what it has earned."

Kana miqatan (was an appointed time): that is, a time fixed and determined by Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, so it neither comes early nor late.

Yawma yunfakhu fi al-sur (the Day the Trumpet is blown): that is, the Day Israfil blows into the Trumpet.

Fa-ta'tuna afwajan (and you will come in multitudes): that is, you, O people, will come in groups upon groups to the arena of the judgment.

Wa futihat al-sama' (and the sky will be opened): that is, for the descent of the angels.

Wa suyyirat al-jibal (and the mountains will be set in motion): that is, they will be carried away from their places.

Fa-kanat sarab (and they will become like a mirage): that is, like a mirage, where one sees water though it is not water; so too the mountains.

Inna Jahannam kanat mirsadan (Indeed, Hell has been lying in wait): that is, lying in wait for them, a place of lying in wait for the wrongdoers, a place of return to which they will return.

Labithina fiha ahqaban (remaining in it for ages): that is, eras without end.

La yadhuquna fiha bardan (they will not taste therein any coolness): that is, sleep, nor any drink they would enjoy, since their drink is boiling water.

Wa ghassaqan (and dark, foul liquid): that is, what flows from the pus of the people of the Fire, given to them as a punishment.

Jaza'an wifaqan (a fitting recompense): since there is no sin greater than disbelief, and no punishment greater than the Fire.

Kizzaban (denial): that is, denial.

Fa-lan nazidakum illa 'adhaban (so We will not increase you except in punishment): that is, above the punishment you are already in.

Meaning of the verses:

After Allah mentioned the signs of His power over resurrection and recompense, which the polytheists denied and disputed, He here gave a comprehensive account of the Last Resurrection and what takes place in it. He began by mentioning the events of the cosmic upheaval, then mentioned in detail the recompense of the tyrants. He, the Mighty and Majestic, said: ﴿Indeed, the Day of Decision﴾, that is, the separation among creatures, "was an appointed time" for what Allah has prepared for those who denied His meeting, disbelieved in His oneness, and rejected the messenger of their Prophet, and on it He will recompense them with the fullest recompense. Then He mentioned events that precede it, saying: ﴿The Day the Trumpet is blown﴾, that is, the Day Israfil blows the blast of resurrection, which is the second blast, ﴿and you will come in multitudes﴾, that is, in groups. ﴿And the sky will be opened﴾, that is, split open, ﴿and will become gates﴾ for the descent of the angels from it. ﴿And the mountains will be set in motion, and they will become a mirage﴾, scattered dust, like a mirage in the eye of the beholder. As for His saying: ﴿Indeed, Hell has been lying in wait﴾, that is, after the reckoning comes the recompense, and behold, Hell has been made ready and prepared, so it is a place of lying in wait. A place of lying in wait for whom? For the tyrants who transgressed the limit set for them, which is that they should believe in their Lord, worship Him alone, and draw near to Him by doing what He loves and abandoning what He dislikes. But they went beyond that to disbelief in their Lord, associating others with Him, denying His Messenger, doing what He dislikes and abandoning what He loves. These are the tyrants for whom Hell has been set in readiness, so it became for them a place of lying in wait, a place of return and a final abode. ﴿They will remain therein for ages﴾, that is, eras. ﴿They will not taste therein any coolness﴾, that is, sleep, because sleep is called "bard" (coolness) in the language of some Arabs. ﴿Nor any drink﴾ that brings pleasure, ﴿except boiling water﴾, which is scalding water, ﴿and dark, foul liquid﴾, which is what flows from the pus of the people of the Fire, ﴿a fitting recompense﴾, that is, corresponding to their sins, since there is no sin greater than disbelief, nor any punishment greater than the Fire. Then Allah mentioned the reason for this punishment, saying: ﴿Indeed, they did not expect a reckoning﴾, that is, they did not believe in the reckoning or the recompense, and did not fear it. ﴿And they denied Our signs with utter denial﴾, that is, they denied His signs and proofs with excessive denial.

As for His saying: ﴿And everything We have enumerated in a Record﴾, since the angels were recording their deeds and counting them against them, they receive their just recompense, and it is said to them as reproach and rebuke while they are in the most severe and bitter torment: ﴿So taste! For We will not increase you except in punishment.﴾ Thus their distress grows greater, and despair becomes firmly fixed in their souls. This is the recompense of one who disowned his intellect, disbelieved in his Lord, believed in Satan, and worshipped his desires. We seek refuge with Allah, the Exalted.

Guidance from the verses:

1- Condemnation of tyranny and explanation of the recompense of the wrongdoers.

2- Condemnation of denial of resurrection and of those who deny it.

3- The deeds of servants, believer and disbeliever alike, are all recorded against them and they will be recompensed for them.

4- Affirmation of the belief in resurrection and recompense by mentioning its effects.

5- Eternity of punishment in the Hereafter and the impossibility of its ending.
